_comment: Owner-maintained map from a message template to the workflow that sends it. GHL does not record the workflow on a message, so the dashboard cannot work this out by itself. templateStartsWith is the template's opening words exactly as the Conversations cards show them (lower case, no names, numbers, links, or punctuation); the cards match on 'starts with', longest match wins. Fill in workflow with the workflow's name as it appears in GHL (the 72 workflow names can be listed read-only). Leave workflow blank for templates you do not recognise; they show as 'not mapped'. The note is generated for reference and can be edited or removed. Re-run the generator (scratch script) or add entries by hand as new templates appear.
